title: Acceptance probability equals output probability
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over Boolean symbols, let $x$ be a Boolean input, and let $T,t\in\mathbb{N}$. If every run on $x$ given a choice word of length $T$ halts, and $T\le t$, then the probability that $N$ accepts within $t$ steps equals the probability that a uniformly chosen Boolean choice word of length $T$ produces output $[\mathrm{true}]$.
